svg.aria-label: Lumen screen probes: rough specular indirect
svg.title: Lumen screen probes: rough specular indirect
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: rough specular indirect graph 0001 | ScreenProbeIntegrate SupportAll | pass 181 | view rect 1280x720 valid rough-specular radiance estimate (shared tonemap) INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel valid zero non-finite RoughSpecularIndirect is the screen-probe rough-specular radiance estimate; the composite applies the material specular colour/EnvBRDF. The array is a 1280x888 Texture2DArray slice 0; only the exact 1280x720 view rect is shown. Empty/invalid tiles are categorical magenta; a valid zero is black. The display scale is the 99th percentile of this figure's valid radiance, recorded in display.transform.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
